_meta.description: Deterministic data on small business survival rates, revenue benchmarks, operational costs, industry-specific metrics, and growth channels. Covers 35 categories: survival by year/industry/funding/experience, failure reasons, revenue by type, profitability, hiring costs, turnover, CAC, LTV, restaurant/cafe/ecommerce/SaaS/agency/consulting/retail/food truck/gym specifics, marketing ROI, email benchmarks.
